long_description:
Khotan is the platform for forward-deployed engineers to rebuild operations as software and maintain them. It combines your context with the infrastructure harnesses need to deploy, share, and maintain each application.

Across procurement, supply chain, finance, and operations, we’ve rebuilt the systems businesses cannot afford to get wrong.

Learn more at khotan.com
name: Khotan (formerly Pollinate)
one_liner: FDE as a platform for rebuilding critical operations in software.
